state restore invalidation
arena reclamation and epoch invalidation
overclock specialization invalidation
reset invalidates cache metadata
allocation failure interpreter fallback
unload frees cache
empty and nonempty slice budgets before/at/after 96 units
PAL/NTSC exact cycle credit and whole-instruction overshoot
branch/index page crossing, stack, PPU/APU bus operations
IRQ/NMI, DMC DMA, APU frame and Namco IRQ deadlines
previous instruction carry and complete serialized state
APU frame and DMC deadlines before/at/after instruction boundary
independent interpreter scheduler deadlines and pending cycle carry
DMC DMA combined with frame or bit events
Namco IRQ disabled, threshold, overflow and branch cycle carry
both native branch targets; target operand mutation; restored chain epoch
masked IRQ native chains and temporary IRQ clearing
long 16-op native chains crossing the 15-bit packet boundary
exact CPU/RAM/timestamps and full serialized state
Exact unsigned byte comparison including first mismatch
All source/destination alignments and word/64-byte tails
No reads outside requested input spans; complete destination buffer oracle
Return pointer, destination sentinels, overlapping memmove
memory.limitation: Actual MIPS semantics, not physical cache/bus timing. Write hooks fault on baseline branch-delay byte stores; writes checked with full-buffer canaries instead.

row-cache.limitation: Actual MIPS software execution, not physical H1 timing.

save-audio.limitation: Storage is deliberately silent. This does not remove IO latency or establish physical-device performance.

default-skip.limitation: Normal mock input and verified settings; not physical firmware timing.

exit-key.limitation: Mocked services do not establish physical H1 timing or audio quality.

cpu_qa.test_fixture_adjustment: Warm status block uses seven PPU cycles. Pending DMA and already-fetched opcode tests each retain the original one-cycle C-path case and add a seven-cycle native-admission case; callback, CPU, timestamp and serialized-state assertions remain.

first_run_limitations: Game-specific title/level/action results require visual inspection of screenshots
